purpose: Approval-only UI concepts; app code unchanged

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium, production-feasible mobile wellness app UI concept board, landscape 1536x1024, two straight-on large phone screens side by side with very slim frames. Turkish UI. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the midnight navy #001426, crescent moon, subtle luminous dune/horizon, soft mint #9DE3D0, warm champagne #EED6A4, refined futuristic calm. Redesign information architecture completely around LARGE RECTANGULAR selection tiles with generously rounded 22px corners, BIG SIMPLE recognizable pictograms, 1-2 word labels, extremely little text. Crisp vector-like thick-enough 2px icons, about 60px in each tile; no tiny ornamental wire icons. No paragraphs, no huge greeting wasting space, no busy illustration backgrounds or excessive bloom. Highly legible white text on solid navy tiles. Each main feature tile has a discreet visible circled i at upper right, plus its big symbol. i has its own generous touch target. Every icon HAS a short label. Visual mood is quiet luxury with understated edge glow, not a gaming dashboard.
LEFT screen, title "Bugün", small "NutriGuide" top left and small circular avatar top right. Compact selectable chip "Modum · Sakin" with small moon. One prominent full-width rectangular food hero "Bugünkü tabağın", beautiful warm photo of chickpea bulgur tomato bowl on right, left short "15 dk" and label "Beslen" with arrow. Directly below a 2x2 grid of very large feature rectangles: "Nefes" big flowing three-wave pictogram and "2 dk"; "Uyku" big crescent and "Akşam"; "Hareket" big simple walking person and "10 dk"; "Su" big water drop and "+250 ml". Small bottom text action "Ana ekranı düzenle" with sliders glyph. Five-tab floating rounded nav at bottom: "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil", each recognizable icon+label, Bugün mint selection. Entire main actions visible above nav, no chopped cards.
RIGHT screen title "Keşfet", subtitle only "İyi oluş alanların", compact search pill "Ne yapmak istersin?". Uniform 2-column x 3-row LARGE RECTANGULAR tiled menu, dominant pictograms: "Beslenme" bowl; "Uyku" crescent; "Hareket" walking; "Zihin" flowing orb; "Su" droplet; "Alışkanlıklar" calendar with check. Same circled i each. Below, a full-width rectangle "Sağlık verileri" with LARGE clean watch and ring symbols, short state "Bağlantı kur" and chevron. Same bottom nav, Keşfet selected mint. These categories contain EXISTING basic capabilities; no AI coach, yoga programs, ring scores or fake health stats. Screen content is a proposed redesign, not an existing screenshot.
Outside phones small elegant board title "01 / Görerek seç" top left, footer "Tasarım önerisi · Henüz uygulanmadı". All Turkish lettering exact, professional balanced high fidelity product presentation. Reference has thin row lists; CHANGE these to big chunky rectangular visual tiles as described while retaining the same atmospheric family.

Use case: ui-mockup. Design board 02 of the NutriGuide visual-first wellness redesign. Two very large straight-on phone UI screens, landscape1536x1024. Attached image is reference for EXACT design system, card treatments, fonts, icon style, midnight navy and mint, quiet crescent/horizon background; do not copy its screen content. Buildable Flutter UI with simple rectangular panels and ordinary bottom sheet. Large clear graphical controls, tiny amount of prose, big recognizable pictograms and short Turkish labels. High quality photoreal warm bowl only where relevant; other icons vector-like solid/2px outline. Native crisp typography. No visual health score, medical claims or long poetic header.
LEFT phone "Beslenme", small back arrow, top corner i. Compact subtitle "Sana uygun seçimler". Below short legible outlined preference badges with shield: "Süt ürünü yok" and "Gluten içerir" (this example user has no gluten allergy; warning MUST be visible outside info). Large rectangular hero with beautiful warm chickpea bulgur tomato bowl occupying top-right, name "Nohutlu bulgur", small "15 dk · Hazır malzemeyle", big mint "Tarifi aç" button at bottom within card. Circled i top-right of hero has an outlined halo suggesting tapping. Under hero 2x2 big rectangular menu tiles with very large simple pictograms and 1-word labels: "Tarifler" open recipe book, "Mutfak" pantry jar, "Öğün planı" calendar and fork, "Alışveriş" basket. Each tile has a discreet i. Five tab nav EXACT labels "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil"; Keşfet selected mint. Minimal copy, highly readable.
RIGHT phone SAME food screen visibly dimmed behind modal, so user understands relationship. A dark navy opaque bottom sheet over lower 60% with rounded top corners, drag handle and accessible X close top-right. Title "Neden bu tabak?" with prominent champagne bowl glyph, three horizontal short reason rows with big symbols: shield "Tercihlerinle eşleşiyor"; clock "Hazır malzemeyle 15 dk"; bowl "Baklagil + tahıl + sebze". Below small framed source line "Profilin + tarif içeriği". Accordion row "Malzemeleri ve alerjenleri gör" with chevron (details on demand); no claim allergen-free. Bottom broad mint button "Anladım". Critical gluten badge on underlying food screen was already visible; info is optional explanation, never a compulsory extra step before main action. Right sheet has no bottom navigation overlaying it. Whitespace, concise typography, restrained glow.
Outside phones title "02 / Ayrıntı, istediğinde" and footer "Tasarım önerisi · Örnek tarif". Match first concept board consistency. All text exactly Turkish with proper diacritics. Do not add extra copy, unreadable placeholders, notifications or backend implementation details.

Use case: ui-mockup. Third design board for NutriGuide, landscape 1536x1024. THREE large straight-on phone screens arranged side by side, with equal sizes and perfectly matched UI geometry. Reference image gives EXACT design system: large rounded rectangular icon tiles, midnight navy, luminous moon/horizon, huge clear recognizable pictograms, very little Turkish copy, refined premium futuristic calm. This board explains OPTIONAL USER-SELECTED mood atmosphere, not health diagnosis. The same screen across all three phones MUST have identical card positions, titles, durations, meal, labels, navigation, and information buttons; ONLY accent tint and subtle background texture/glow vary. No reordering, no changing food recommendations in this comparison.
Board title outside phones "03 / Aynı uygulama, senin atmosferin". Above phones concise separate labels: LEFT "Dinlenme", CENTER "Denge", RIGHT "Canlı". Phone content each: small NutriGuide wordmark and round initial N avatar. Compact large heading "Bugün". A small mood chip varies only text: left "Modum · Yorgun", center "Modum · Sakin", right "Modum · Enerjik". Behind compact header a subtle crescent and dune horizon, no giant empty decorative header. Then identical wide bowl photo rectangular hero "Bugünkü tabağın", "15 dk", small arrow action "Beslen", circled i. Below identical 2x2 large rectangular tiles: top left flowing wave icon "Nefes" and "2 dk"; top right crescent icon "Uyku" and "Akşam"; bottom left walking person icon "Hareket" and "10 dk"; bottom right drop icon "Su" and "+250 ml". Every card has a tiny circled i top-right with whitespace. Below a compact pill with lock symbol and words "Görünümü sabitle". Bottom nav in every phone labels EXACT "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil"; Bugün selected.
LEFT: still deep navy base, matte soft lavender #C8B9EE on selected nav, wave icon and subtle tile edge; very low texture smooth dark-violet horizon, pale champagne moon. Restful and inviting, NOT greyed out, disabled or gloomy; text remains bright white.
CENTER: original deep navy #001426, mint #9DE3D0 primary accent, original champagne moon, clean soft moonlit horizon.
RIGHT: same deep navy, luminous but restrained pale turquoise #94DFE4 primary accent, crisp thin turquoise aurora along dune horizon, slightly more defined texture, still calm and highly legible; NO neon rainbow, no light mode, no orange screen.
All functional warnings if any would remain semantic, but no warnings needed on this comparison. Keep white text on dark opaque cards at all times. Font sizes identical across phones. Exquisitely consistent simple vector icons, no emoji. Three phones readable, edge-to-edge large use of board, no giant outside margins. Footer outside phones "Tasarım önerisi · Mod uyumu isteğe bağlı". No charts, health scores, extra text or paragraphs.
